metadata.title: research-arxiv-scout - Sources
metadata.description: Official arXiv docs plus complementary discovery and citation tooling used to scout, validate, and curate research links

arxiv_official.name: arXiv API Documentation
arxiv_official.description: Official arXiv API docs and guidelines

arxiv_official.name: arXiv API Terms of Use
arxiv_official.description: Attribution and usage requirements for arXiv API consumers

arxiv_official.name: arXiv Category Taxonomy
arxiv_official.description: Complete category list (cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG, etc.)

arxiv_official.name: arXiv Search Help
arxiv_official.description: Search syntax and operator reference for arXiv site search

arxiv_official.name: arXiv Monthly Submissions
arxiv_official.description: Trends by category over time (useful for monitoring activity)

arxiv_official.name: arXiv RSS Feeds
arxiv_official.description: Per-category RSS feeds updated daily ~midnight ET. Replace {category} with e.g. cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.CL. Use as the first step in the daily-digest workflow.

arxiv_official.name: arXiv New Listings
arxiv_official.description: HTML new-submission listing pages per category. Replace {cat} with e.g. cs.AI. Updated each weekday; useful for visual daily review alongside RSS.

programmatic_metadata.name: Semantic Scholar API
programmatic_metadata.description: Citation and metadata API for verification and enrichment. Unauthenticated requests share a pool of 5,000 requests/5 min across all callers; since August 2024 free personal-email API keys and 3rd-party-app keys are no longer approved (allenai/s2-folks release notes). Verify current limits before bulk citation chasing.

programmatic_metadata.name: OpenAlex
programmatic_metadata.description: Open catalog of scholarly works and citations. Since 13 Feb 2026 every API request requires a free API key (create at openalex.org/settings/api); the old mailto polite pool is gone. Pricing is usage-based ($1/day free allowance; ID lookups free, search calls ~$1/1000) -- verify current terms at developers.openalex.org/guides/authentication before high-volume pulls.

discovery_tools.name: Semantic Scholar
discovery_tools.description: Paper discovery with citation graphs and metadata

discovery_tools.name: Hugging Face Papers
discovery_tools.description: Daily paper highlights and community discussion; primary replacement for Papers with Code social signal

discovery_tools.name: Hugging Face Trending
discovery_tools.description: Trending models, datasets, and spaces; useful for code-release signals alongside HF Papers

discovery_tools.name: Connected Papers
discovery_tools.description: Visual exploration of related papers and prior work

discovery_tools.name: alphaXiv
discovery_tools.description: Social signal layer on top of arXiv: comments, trending papers, and discussion threads. Use as a pre-triage filter before deep API triage.

discovery_tools.name: Emergent Mind
discovery_tools.description: Aggregates arXiv paper signals from X (Twitter), Reddit, GitHub, and HN. Free tier. Useful for identifying papers with broad cross-community attention early.

discovery_tools.name: arxiv-sanity-lite
discovery_tools.description: Karpathy's SVM-based arXiv recommender. Learns from papers you mark as interesting; good for personalised daily digests.

discovery_tools.name: ResearchRabbit
discovery_tools.description: Citation-network discovery tool. Builds visual citation graphs from seed papers and surfaces related prior and future work. Acquired by Litmaps (relaunched Oct 2025); now freemium (free + paid tiers) rather than fully free -- confirm current tier limits before relying on bulk exports.

discovery_tools.name: Litmaps
discovery_tools.description: Citation maps with monitor alerts for new papers citing your seeds. Free tier available. Acquired ResearchRabbit in Oct 2025; the two products remain separately branded as of mid-2026.

discovery_tools.name: Zeta Alpha
discovery_tools.description: Neural search over arXiv and other AI/ML preprint sources. Free web interface; useful for semantic queries that keyword search misses.

discovery_tools.name: codesota.com
discovery_tools.description: Leaderboard and benchmark lookup for code-related tasks. Use for state-of-the-art comparisons previously served by Papers with Code leaderboards.

dead_or_changed.name: Papers with Code
dead_or_changed.description: DEAD as of July 2025. paperswithcode.com now 301-redirects to Hugging Face Trending; GitHub data is frozen. Replaced by: HF Papers (huggingface.co/papers) for social signal, HF Trending (huggingface.co/trending) for code-release signals, and codesota.com for leaderboard lookups.

dead_or_changed.name: arXiv export API endpoint
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: stricter 429 enforcement from Feb 2026 — hard 1 request / 3s, single connection. Previously a politeness request, now enforced. Parallel query bursts are the fastest route to a throttle. Replacement: same endpoint; enforce the 3s gap in all query scripts (scripts/generate_arxiv_scout_queries.py reports estimated_min_runtime_seconds for this reason). See references/arxiv-api-guide.md#rate-limiting-enforced-as-of-2026.

dead_or_changed.name: OpenAlex
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: API key mandatory since 2026-02-13; the mailto polite-pool parameter is retired. Keyed requests get $1/day free credit (covers usual research volume); unkeyed requests get $0.10/day then 409. Replacement: same service — register a free key at openalex.org/settings/api. Primary fallback when Semantic Scholar keys are unavailable.

dead_or_changed.name: Semantic Scholar API
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: key now officially recommended; ~1 RPS authenticated; exponential backoff required. Since Aug 2024 free personal-email keys and 3rd-party-app keys are no longer approved — apply with an institutional email or fall back to OpenAlex. Replacement: same service; register at semanticscholar.org/product/api.

dead_or_changed.name: Connected Papers
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: paid tier introduced 2025; free plan limited to 50 inputs/searches. Replacement for bulk citation-graph work: OpenAlex citation graph (free with key) or the Semantic Scholar graph API.

dead_or_changed.name: ICLR / OpenReview
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: OpenReview API v2 is mandatory; v1 is deprecated and all 2026 venues are on v2. Affects any attempt to verify a claimed ICLR acceptance against the venue rather than trusting the author's arXiv comment field. Replacement: same venue; use API v2 endpoints.

dead_or_changed.name: ResearchRabbit
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: acquired by Litmaps (2025-05-08; relaunched Oct 2025) and moved from fully free to freemium. Confirm current tier limits before relying on bulk exports. Replacement: Litmaps (litmaps.com) free tier, or OpenAlex for programmatic citation-network work.
